system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hey there! This is Noah Patel. I hope you’re having a less chaotic week than me! So, here’s the deal: I had this whole work-from-home plan cooked up, right? Ordered three home office things and some hiking gear—figured I’d work remote from my folks’ place in Seattle and finally touch some grass. But, plot twist: my company just announced we’re all heading back to the office soon. Classic, right?

So, I was wondering—can I cancel just the home office items from my order and keep the hiking stuff? Honestly, I can’t even remember exactly what I ordered for the office (it’s been a week, my brain is mush), but I know there were three things. If you can cancel just those, could you tell me how much I’ll get back, and make sure the refund goes to my original payment method?

If it’s not possible to cancel just part of the order, can we change the shipping address to my place in NYC (10108)? I’ll just return the office stuff once it arrives. Either way, I appreciate your help—my life’s a sitcom lately!

Hello? Just checking if you’re still there! Sorry, I tend to ramble when I’m nervous—WFH whiplash and all that.

- If you can do that, let me know how much I’ll get back and please refund it to my original payment method.

Let me know what’s possible! And if you need any more info from me, just ask—I promise I’ll try to be less scatterbrained this time.
